reviews.text: Waited 45 minutes for a burger that arrived cold. Server was apologetic but kitchen was clearly slammed.
The mushroom ramen is the best thing I've eaten all year. Ask for extra chili crisp!
Found a piece of plastic in my salad. I have photos and I am contacting the health department.
Great patio vibes and the staff remembered our anniversary. Music was a bit loud inside.
BEST DEALS CHECK MY PROFILE FOR CRYPTO SIGNALS!!! also food ok
Menu says the tacos are gluten-free but the tortillas are clearly flour. Please fix your menu, I have celiac.
Our server Maya turned a rough travel day around. She deserves a raise.
The host was openly rude about my service dog and asked us to leave. This is illegal.
$19 for a cocktail that was mostly ice. Portions have shrunk since last year.
Solid brunch. The 25-minute wait for coffee refills is the only reason this isn't five stars.
Pretty sure this place gave me food poisoning Friday night. Shrimp tasted off.
Took my team of 12 here for a launch dinner. Private room, flawless timing, everyone raved.
